endorsements.quote: Outcome-based, prospective validation is essential before AI-driven tools can be trusted in routine clinical workflows.

However, final decision-making must remain with experienced clinicians who can integrate contextual factors, ethical considerations, and patient-specific nuances that are difficult for current algorithms to interpret.

unlisted_practices: Develop explainable, context-aware AI systems that allow clinicians to understand the factors influencing predictions.
Conduct future research on prospective, real-world validation of AI tools.

screen.reason: This is an editorial discussing why AI performance on medical exams does not equate to clinical judgment and recommending how AI validation and use should be approached.
